_doc: Paint, refutation round 2 (2026-11-23), after round 1's fixes, on 20 fresh boxes (refute.py r2: junctions at s 108, 738, 1175, 2000, 2480, 3120, 3746, 4390, 5810, 6030; mid-block at s 420, 1000, 1800, 2380, 2850, 3200, 4050, 4700, 5350, 6330). 3 boxes were read before the remaining cause was plain; the rest were not counted. Counts by eye, approximate.

boxes_read.what: four crosswalks, two stop bars and the turn guide read; missed: lane dashes on the west approach; false (detected): older-year fragments on the sidewalk

boxes_read.box: j2000 15th St / Champa, half under a tower's shadow in 2022
boxes_read.what: false (measured): two stripes of an off-street parking lot inside the look-window. The shadowed half cannot be judged on the 2022 picture: most of its items are 2020 fills. Not typed and visible: two BUS legends on red, a through-left arrow, a bike symbol. Crosswalk bars in the shadow: about a third read
false (measured): the gutter's lip along the north kerb read as a solid white line, twice; green bike markings not read

causes_and_fixes: a long white mark within 0.6 m of the flooded roadway's rim whose sides differ by 25 luminance steps 0.9 m out is the gutter's lip or the kerb: dropped in the tile stage (paint_tile.py)
off-street parking stripes inside the look-window: NOT fixed (they are paint, on pavement, within reach of the OSM line); counted as false in every round
